technology_name: N-Stage OTA Buffer Amplifier with High Input Dynamic Range and Tunable Gain
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Analog Integrated Circuit / Signal Buffering Unit
problem_solved: Standard operational transconductance amplifiers (OTAs) suffer from a narrow input dynamic range and fail to drive heavy resistance loads efficiently without major signal drop-offs.
description: A high-performance N-stage operational transconductance amplifier architecture engineered with a series-voltage feedback configuration, multiple internal feedback blocks, and tunable gain stages to ensure completely balanced voltage output levels.
applications: High-precision analog-to-digital converter (ADC) drivers, consumer audio equipment amplifiers, biomedical sensor instrumentation channels, and industrial signal telemetry boards.
secondary_sector: MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
